issues.title: Linear-time union in scan ConjunctionOr filter
issues.hypothesis: After E0001, q19 is dominated by the lineitem TABLE_SCAN (3.3s cumulative of ~3.6s). Isolated with dbe-tool sql: `count(*) WHERE l_quantity OR-of-3-ranges` takes 0.342s (scan 2.62s cumulative), while `l_quantity BETWEEN 9 AND 33` (same rows touched, one range) takes 0.099s (0.70s), and the shipinstruct eq filter alone takes 0.125s. So the OR table filter costs about 3.5x a plain range. The cause is in ColumnSegment::FilterSelection, case CONJUNCTION_OR (src/storage/table/column_segment.cpp:413-444). For every row that passes child k, it scans linearly through all rows already put into result_sel to remove duplicates. That is O(n^2) per vector: about 1000 passing rows of 2048 means about 10^6 compares per vector. Replacing it with a per-vector bitmap union is O(n) and should bring the OR filter close to the cost of a single range.
issues.plan:
In ColumnSegment::FilterSelection CONJUNCTION_OR (src/storage/table/column_segment.cpp):
1. Allocate a local `bool matched[STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE]` (or uint8), zeroed only for the indices in the incoming sel. sel indices are row offsets inside the scanned vector, so they are < STANDARD_VECTOR_SIZE. Add a D_ASSERT for this.
2. For each child: build `remaining_sel` holding the rows of the input sel that are not yet matched, in order. Skip the child if it is empty. Copy it into temp_sel and call FilterSelection(child) on it with remaining_count. Set matched[idx]=true for each passing idx.
3. Afterwards, iterate the original input sel in order and emit matched indices into result_sel. The output keeps input order (sorted) and has no duplicates. Then do sel.Initialize(result_sel) and approved_tuple_count = count.
This preserves semantics: the union of the rows each child passes. Evaluating later children only on unmatched rows is valid because a row already in the union does not need re-testing. Also look at whether ExpressionFilter or ZoneMap code in src/planner/filter/conjunction_filter.cpp has a similar quadratic union. Fix only if it is on the hot path.
issues.expected_gain: q19: the lineitem scan OR filter drops from ~2.6s to ~0.8s cumulative. Expect q19 at -30..-50% (159ms -> ~90ms).
issues.generality: Any scan with a pushed-down OR table filter on one column: OR'd ranges, OR'd equalities that are not converted to IN, and OR filters derived by JoinDependentFilterRule (Q19-like disjunctive queries). It is a pure algorithmic fix with no plan changes, so nothing should get slower. Output order becomes sorted by row position, which the AND path already produces.
issues.risk: Low. The change is local. Points to watch: sel may be uninitialized (null pointer means identity), so use sel.get_index. Children may reorder or modify temp_sel, so copy before each child. NULL handling is unchanged because the children handle validity.

dispatch: Linear-time union in scan ConjunctionOr filter
output.memory:
# Memory

## Round 1 (gen 1) findings
- q19 is the only visible template (TPC-H Q19 shape: OR of 3 branches, each with join eq + part preds + lineitem preds). Baseline ~307ms hot.
- E0001 ACCEPTED (-46%): JoinDependentFilterRule (src/optimizer/rule/join_dependent_filter.cpp) only fires on ROOT OR; DistributivityRule factored the join eq out first. Fixed by reordering in optimizer.cpp. q19 now ~159ms.
- ExpressionRewriter::ApplyRules: is_root=true only on top call from VisitExpression; fixpoint loop re-enters with is_root=true. Rewriter runs once per optimization.
- dbe-tool sql cannot run shell loops/pipes/variables; run single statements (grep pipe on output OK). Single-run timings noisy.

## Round 2 (gen 1) findings
- After E0001 the lineitem TABLE_SCAN is ~90% of q19 (3.3s cumulative). Microbenchmarks (EXPLAIN ANALYZE count(*) on lineitem):
  - l_quantity OR of 3 ranges: 0.342s total (scan 2.62s cum)
  - l_quantity BETWEEN 9 AND 33 (single range): 0.099s (0.70s cum)
  - l_shipinstruct = const: 0.125s (0.92s cum)
  - shipinstruct + quantity OR: 0.347s, so the BF on partkey and shipmode are minor.
- Root cause: ColumnSegment::FilterSelection CONJUNCTION_OR (src/storage/table/column_segment.cpp ~413) removes duplicates in the union with an O(n^2) linear search over result_sel. Dispatched: bitmap union + evaluate later children only on unmatched rows.
- Scan filter loop: RowGroup::Scan (src/storage/table/row_group.cpp ~760) applies filters in AdaptiveFilter permutation order, then Select()s the other columns with sel.
- BFTableFilter (src/planner/filter/bloom_filter.cpp) is a simple blocked BF and looked fine.
- The FILTER op above the scan (optional shipmode IN re-check) gets ~29k tiny chunks (82k rows / 29k vectors). Its 0.12s cum is per-chunk overhead. Small target.

## Next ideas if the OR fix lands
- Merge OR'd overlapping or adjacent ranges on one column into fewer ranges at filter-pushdown time. Probably only minor once the union is linear.
- Backlog issue (optional IN on dict strings in scan) is low value now: the shipmode FILTER sees only 82k rows.
- After the fix, re-profile: the remaining scan cost is likely the shipinstruct dictionary compare plus decoding quantity/partkey.
